facts.fact: A World Bank implementation report says 4,574,257 individuals were registered in the civil registration database (e-SIRCEV) by 20 March 2026, against a target of 13 million, with entry of existing records and digitisation of historical records planned.

MOZ.note: Gives 11,038,940 people registered in the civil identification database on 20 March 2026 but no population or share, so no value can be drawn from this document alone.
Document states nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
Only an identity verification API awaiting feedback from institutions, with no relying party using it; no register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: A World Bank implementation report says 11 million IDs have been issued and 11,038,940 individuals were registered in the civil identification database by 20 March 2026, against a target of 17 million.
